question: Which components in the marginally converged source-position programs remain causally necessary in the complete program, and which greedy additions became redundant through distributed interactions?

frozen_design.interventions: For every task and panel, evaluate the complete source-position program and each exact leave-one-component-out program against the same native base and donor endpoints.
frozen_design.necessity_score: complete-program mean recovery minus leave-one-out mean recovery
frozen_design.core_rule: A label is core when its necessity score is positive on both panels and its row-count-pooled score is at least 0.01.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_finiteness_a: Authorities, bank widths, capability, finiteness, record coverage, and exact price all pass.
predictions.pred_b_complete_programs_reproduce: Every complete-program mean recovery reproduces the convergence receipt within 1e-6.
predictions.pred_c_majority_of_each_program_is_core: At least half of each program's labels satisfy the frozen core rule.
predictions.pred_d_task_exclusive_components_are_fun: Each task has at least one task-exclusive core component.
predictions.pred_e_shared_mlp_backbone_is_jointly_ne: At least four of the six shared MLP labels are core in both tasks.

decision: screen seals the core paths for compression; null records redundancy or task/panel instability without changing the core threshold; invalid on authority, capability, finiteness, coverage, reproduction, or price failure
